response.overview: The last wish of seriously ill Jiang Li is to return home.Despite his wife's advice, he rode his motorcycle back to his ancestral home alone, where he saw his old aunt. Jiang Li's parents have passed away.When his aunt handed him the toys (hoop, birdcage and harmonica) his parents had left for him,their memories of these objects are totally different.In particular, the harmonica, Jiang Li remember it is a pledge with Xiao Juan (his teenage lover back in high school),but the aunt said she bought it for Jiang to accompany him to through the hard time in senior year of high school.
